_comment: Add school-specific patterns here, e.g. a student/staff ID format from the SIS. Each pattern needs: name, regex (a Python re pattern, double-escaped for JSON), optional severity ('warning' or 'error', default 'warning'), and for email-like patterns only, allow_domains to skip known-placeholder domains. A calling repo can override this whole file by keeping its own pii-patterns.json at its root instead of falling back to this one.
